0.tail: 已归一到 -2..2（滑杆/50） / normalised to -2..2 (slider / 50)

1.tail: 肤色保护强度 0..1 / skin protection 0..1

2.div: 色域边界容差（小于它视为在色域内，避免末位抖动）/ gamut tolerance

3.div: LAB 转换（D65，输入为线性 sRGB）/ LAB conversion (D65, linear sRGB in)

5.zh: 色度蒙版：C* 越大权重越低，读的是「源图」色度，与 Saturation 互不影响。指数 1.3 让 60 以上的色度掉得比纯双曲线更快，避免高饱和区还在被推
5.en: Chroma mask: the larger C*, the lower the weight. It reads the SOURCE chroma, so Saturation cannot bias it. The 1.3 exponent makes chroma above 60 fall off faster than a plain hyperbola, so vivid colours stop being pushed.

6.zh: 肤色蒙版：LAB 色相落在 55° 附近（橙/肤色带）且色度处于肤色区间时降权。用 smoothstep 做软窗，不会出现一刀切的硬边
6.en: Skin mask: lower the weight when the LAB hue sits near 55 deg (the orange/skin band) and the chroma falls inside the skin range. smoothstep makes it a soft window without a hard edge.

7.div: 色域收敛：沿固定色相与 L 把色度收进 sRGB / gamut convergence

8.zh: 返回能让 (L, a*k, b*k) 留在色域内的最大 k ∈ [0,1]。这一步替代硬裁剪：色相与明度完全不动，只是少加一点饱和度
8.en: Return the largest k in [0,1] that keeps (L, a*k, b*k) inside the gamut. This replaces hard clipping: hue and lightness stay put, only a little saturation is given up.

10.zh: 蒙版全部基于源图：色度取 C*，色相取 h_ab
10.en: all masks come from the source image: chroma from C*, hue from h_ab

11.zh: 全局饱和度与自然饱和度相乘，两者互不污染
11.en: global saturation multiplies the natural gain; neither pollutes the other

12.zh: 沿原色相放大色度，等价于 a *= scale、b *= scale，不需要三角运算
12.en: grow chroma along the original hue; that equals a *= scale and b *= scale, no trigonometry needed

13.zh: 出界就沿同一条色相射线收回来，不做逐通道裁剪
13.en: if it leaves the gamut, pull it back along the same hue ray instead of clipping per channel
